# AIS-DATA-01

**Is every grounding source a named, owned and classified data set?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | DATA: Grounding and data |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.grounding.sources`, `data` |

## Rule

Every grounding source resolves to a data set, and that data set has used_for_ai grounding.

## Sources

- Microsoft, Azure Well-Architected Framework, AI workloads (`azure-ai`)
- NSA, CISA, FBI and partners, AI Data Security (2025) (`ai-data-security`)
